access_note: Model files are free under CC BY 4.0. PowerWorld Simulator is a separate prerequisite; version 23 used by the study.
description: The University of São Paulo publishes executable power-flow case files for its USP-105 underground medium-voltage feeder. The network incorporates distributed generation from a biogas plant, photovoltaic installations and a small wind turbine. Zenodo provides PowerWorld input files in PWB, PWD and TSB formats, together with CSV results and supporting information, freely under CC BY 4.0. The site-specific model supports comparison of embedded-generation scenarios and checks of feeder loading and voltage. Reproduction requires compatible PowerWorld Simulator software; the study used version 23, and the data licence does not supply a simulator licence. Execution and numerical convergence were not checked. No directly related catalogue model was identified.
